items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I did 'The King' with Basie and Preston Love, who had replaced Earl Warren during the time - he and I both went to the Pennsylvania Station... Earl sat back in the band. I said, 'You got it, Shad, I'll be back later.'

ctx.x: Well Jo, here we are and another day has passed. Now this is Wednesday, January 24th and we're going to continue on talking about Kansas City, after you got out of the Army and came back to Kansas City and you ran into Cab Calloway's band with me hanging around there and we were so glad to see each other again. We finally persuaded you to sit in with us and give us a real treat.

In Omaha, you know... February of '46, of course. I got out the first of February and I did 'The King' with Basie and Preston Love, who had replaced Earl Warren during the time - he and I both went to the Pennsylvania Station, got on a train, and went right straight to Omaha. Earl sat back in the band. I said, "You got it, Shad, I'll be back later."
Oh, Shadow Wilson was in the band?
